content.short: DataCurve enables enterprises to unlock new revenue with Web3 experiences.
content.description: DataCurve helps enterprises unlock new revenue by delivering Web3 experiences to customers. Its flagship product, Logicware, is a complete middleware platform that bridges Web2 and Web3 by integrating smart-contract payments, GenAI imaging and video, data management, digital assets, and AI-based metadata. Aura, Smart Profiles simplifies the customer experience, allowing brands to focus on delivering a seamless user journey. The company focuses on sports, entertainment, brands, and digital financial assets.
